newsitem.title: FRANCE: Rhone set to sell Novacarb to Harris.
newsitem.headline: Rhone set to sell Novacarb to Harris.

text.p: Rhone-Poulenc said on Thursday it planned to sign an agreement which would eventually lead to the sale of its Novacarb soda ash business to Harris Chemical Group.
"The plan provides for Harris Chemical Group initially to handle the marketing of the Novacarb products. Industrial synergies will be implemented at the Nancy, France site," it said in a statement.

"After a transitory period, Harris Chemical Group would then acquire 100 percent of Novacarb," it said, adding that the plans were being submitted to staff representatives of Novacarb and Rhone-Poulenc's Rhone-Poulenc Chimi division.

It said the agreement would make the Nancy site an integral part of the Harris Group and result in soda ash production of 2.6 million metric tons, and put Harris Group in third position in that market worldwide.
